messages:
devon: Quick sync  we need a defensible default for auto-fallbacks when quotas spike. A customer experienced flip-flopping during a retry storm and we should avoid that.

nina: Product: quota alone = probe state, not a full flip. Promote only with corroborating signal (errors / p95 latency) or a sustained window.

sam: Runtime plan: emit two event types: `probe_event` and `fallback_event`. Probe includes probe_id, sample_rate, bucket_counts, min_volume_guard. Full fallback logs policy_snapshot + replay_token. We'll also add `fallback_cause` label for metrics.

charlie: SRE: require hysteresis and cooldown. Proposal: either 4 consecutive 15s buckets over threshold OR a 90s sustained breach to promote. Cooldown 45s after change. Operator override allowed but must be timeboxed.

maria: UX: show inline chip on rollout list like "probe(quota)" with a tiny sparkline. Drawer shows probe_id, sample coverage, sampled traces, a human-friendly "why" sentence, and CTAs: "promote", "pause auto-fallback", "export snapshot". Promotion modal must display the policy snapshot and the replay token.

leila: Product: operator actions must be immutable logs with who/timestamp, exact policy snapshot, and a replay_token for simulator replay. Also require a reason field for audit.

devon: Retention tradeoffs? Compliance asks for 90d for incidents. Storage cost is concerning.

charlie: Compromise: keep full sampled traces + request bodies for 14 days, keep audit metadata, policy snapshots, and trigger counts for 365 days. Provide on-demand deep-retention export for legal holds. I'll attach a cost estimate doc.

sam: Audit payload (single-line JSON string) fields: id, type(probe|fallback), trigger, route, sample_rate, consecutive_buckets, min_requests_window, policy_version, operator_action, replay_token. Example emitted line: {"id":"p-42","type":"probe","trigger":"rate_quota","route":"/v1/chat","sample_rate":0.005,"consecutive_buckets":0,"min_requests_window":50} (will be emitted as a single-line event).

nina: Product wants a default low sample_rate for quota probes (0.25% or 0.5%) and a clear control in the drawer to raise it per-route/customer. Also a min_volume_guard default 50 reqs/window to avoid noisy low-volume tenants.

maria: UI nit: show sample_rate plus estimated coverage (pct of traffic represented) and confidence interval so operators understand representativeness of sampled traces. Also show a short auto-generated rationale like "3/5 buckets above quota threshold; p95 within normal range".

charlie: Add metrics label `fallback_reason=rate_quota|model_error|latency_tail` so dashboards can roll up causes without pulling traces. Also add a circuit-breaker metric for oscillation-rate.

sam: Implementation actions: add probe vs fallback events, `fallback_cause` label, min_volume_guard, single-line audit emit, and replay_token plumbing.

leila: Product actions: spec operator-audit format, replay_token requirements, and UI flows for promote/pause/export.

maria: Design actions: mock chip + drawer + promote modal with side-by-side sample preview and policy snapshot. Include an "explain" sentence generator.

charlie: Ops actions: finalize hysteresis defaults, cooldowns, and retention/cost estimate. Recommend operator overrides auto-expire by default (e.g., 24h) to avoid stale holds.

devon: I'll write a short RFC capturing defaults and tradeoffs and book a 30m follow-up. Thanks all :thumbsup:

opsbot: ci/rollouts/probe-check  canary deployed to 3 routes  smoke OK.

maria: tiny follow-up  when showing sampled responses, tag which ones came from shadow vs baseline.

sam: noted. We'll tag shadow traffic and exempt it from quota/billing so it doesn't affect customer metrics.

leila: final: prod wants the "promote" CTA to show an impact estimate (latency/cost delta) before confirmation.

charlie: good call. we'll add a quick cost/latency delta calc based on sampled responses.

devon: great. locking this thread.
